at 0 command dynamic:player:0000000000000001 GetAV Health
at 0 command content:oblivion.esm:04e936 GetStage

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<1 then return end;t=0
 local found=0
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.containers) do
  if obj.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x24945) then
   found=found+1
   assert(types.ESM4Container.objectIsInstance(obj),'wrong native container type')
   assert((obj.position-util.vector3(-111.7272797,-1847.4641113,-305.2616272)):length()<.01,'wrong original sack position')
   local box=obj:getBoundingBox()
   assert(box.halfSize.x>0 and box.halfSize.y>0 and box.halfSize.z>0,'missing original sack bounds')
  end
 end
 assert(found==1,'original enabled sack missing or duplicated: '..found)
 print('NativeContainerDiscovery count=1 position=true bounds=true type=ESM4Container')
end}}}}
